place.note: The library is located in the outskirts of Wolkite. The site is represented by the mosque and zāwiya founded by šayḫ Muḥammad Raššād al-Qāqī (founder of the raššādiyya ṣūfī order) and Kamāl-Dīn al-Ubbī.
